collection.description: An elder tells of outsiders who once took resources from an island no one can locate.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: An elder tells of outsiders who once took resources from an island no one can locate.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Children remember to protect the reef without fearing every stranger.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: One child grows frightened of imagined visitors.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The elder admits that the account changed over generations.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An old carving appears to resemble the tale but proves nothing.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The children imagine what the visitors might have feared.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The village debates whether sympathy excuses harm.
